units.source_text: 有一天，这大辅命妇和源氏公子闲谈，偶然说起一个人来，

en.t: One day, while this Taifu no Myobu was chatting casually with Prince Genji, she happened to mention someone.

units.source_text: 已故的常陆亲王晚年生下一个女儿，非常疼爱，悉心教养。

en.t: The late Prince of Hitachi had a daughter in his later years, loved her dearly, and raised her with great care.

units.source_text: 现在这女儿死了父亲，生涯十分孤寂。

en.t: Now that her father was dead, the daughter's life was very lonely.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“那是怪可怜的！”便向她探问详情。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "That is terribly pitiful!" and began asking her for the details.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇说：“品性、相貌如何，我知道得不详细。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu said, "As for what her character and appearance are like, I do not know in detail.

units.source_text: 但觉这个人生性好静，对人疏远。

en.t: I only feel that she is quiet by nature and keeps people at a distance.

units.source_text: 有时晚上我去望她，她和我谈话时也隔着帷屏。

en.t: Sometimes when I visit her in the evening, even when she speaks with me she remains behind a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 只有七弦琴是她的知己朋友。”

en.t: Only the seven-stringed koto is her trusted friend."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“琴是三友之一[\[2\]](#part1335.html#m2)，只是最后一个对女子无缘。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "The koto is one of the Three Friends[\[2\]](#part1335.html#m2), though the last of them has little connection with women."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“我想听听她的琴呢。

en.t: Then he added, "I should like to hear her play the koto.

units.source_text: 她父亲常陆亲王是此道的能手，她的手法一定也不平凡。”

en.t: Her father, the Prince of Hitachi, was a master of this art, so her own technique must surely be out of the ordinary."

units.source_text: 大辅命妇说：“也不值得您特地去听吧。”

en.t: Taifu no Myobu said, "It is probably not worth your going out of your way to hear it."
The prince said, "Do not put on airs!

units.source_text: 这几天春夜月色朦胧，让我悄悄地去吧。

en.t: These spring nights have a hazy moonlight, so let me go quietly.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇觉得麻烦，但近日宫中空闲，春日寂寞无事，也就答应了。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu found it troublesome, but since the palace was quiet these days and the spring days were lonely and uneventful, she agreed.

units.source_text: 她的父亲兵部大辅在外面另有一所邸宅，也常常到常陆亲王的旧宅里来探望这个小姐。

en.t: Her father, the Assistant Minister of War, had another residence elsewhere, and he also often came to the late Prince of Hitachi's old mansion to visit this young lady.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇不爱和后母同住，却和这个小姐要好，常常到这里来住宿。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu disliked living with her stepmother, but she was close to this young lady and often came here to stay overnight.
